_comment: Settings that change the DELIVERABLE or the spend policy. Versioned here so every operator produces the same output from the same input. config.json may still override any of these, but `cn-pipeline doctor` reports each override as a warning so drift is visible rather than silent. Paths, storage mode and credentials belong in config.json instead -- those are legitimately per-machine.
_me_gain_comment: Two gains, because the M&E bed arrives two ways. A staff-prepped bed is mixed at full level and must be pulled DOWN under the dubbed VO. A bed separated out of the master by Demucs comes back noticeably quieter, so the same attenuation would bury it -- it needs a boost instead. Which one applies is recorded per project as me_source in runs/{id}/project.json.
